name: When do I need to consider floor level transition improvements?

mainEntity.name: When do I need to consider floor level transition improvements?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider floor level transition improvements when there are noticeable height differences between adjacent rooms, new flooring installations create an uneven surface, or accessibility is a concern. Uneven transitions can be tripping hazards and make it difficult for wheelchairs or strollers to pass. Addressing these issues ensures safety, improves aesthetics, and complies with accessibility standards if applicable.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider improvements when floors are uneven, new flooring creates height differences, or accessibility is a concern to prevent hazards and improve safety.
